context.title: None Other Name
context.summary: Peter and John are arrested and questioned by the council. Peter boldly declares salvation in Jesus alone. Released with threats, the believers pray for boldness, and the place is shaken. They share possessions freely.
context.background: The Sadducees, the priestly party that controlled the temple, were disturbed that the apostles preached resurrection (v. 2). The council recognized Peter and John as 'unlearned and ignorant men' (v. 13), meaning they lacked formal training in the law, not that they could not read.

customs.note: A senior priestly officer who commanded the temple police and kept order in its courts.

watchFor: The rejected stone has become the head of the corner (v. 11).
'We cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard' (v. 20).

people.name: Jesus
people.also: Immanuel, Emmanuel, Messiah, Shiloh, Christ, Jesus Christ, Messias
people.summary: Anointed, the Greek translation of the Hebrew word rendered “Messiah”, the official title of our Lord, occurring five hundred and fourteen times in the New Testament.

people.name: Caiaphas
people.summary: The Jewish high priest (A.D. 27-36) at the beginning of our Lord’s public ministry, in the reign of Tiberius (Luke 3:2), and also at the time of his condemnation and crucifixion (Matt. 26:3, 57; John 11:49; 18:13, 14).

people.name: Annas
people.summary: Was high priest A.D. 7-14. In A.D. 25 Caiaphas, who had married the daughter of Annas (John 18:13), was raised to that office, and probably Annas was now made president of the Sanhedrim, or deputy or coadjutor of the high priest, and thus was also called high priest along with Caiaphas (Luke 3:2).

people.name: Alexander
people.summary: A relative of Annas the high priest, present when Peter and John were examined before the Sanhedrim (Acts 4:6).

people.name: John
people.summary: One who, with Annas and Caiaphas, sat in judgment on the apostles Peter and John (Acts 4:6).

people.name: Holy Spirit
people.summary: The third Person of the adorable Trinity.

people.name: Simon
people.summary: Originally called Simon (=Simeon, i.e., “hearing”), a very common Jewish name in the New Testament. He was the son of Jona (Matt. 16:17). His mother is nowhere named in Scripture.

people.name: John
people.summary: THE APOSTLE, brother of James the “Greater” (Matt. 4:21; 10:2; Mark 1:19; 3:17; 10:35). He was one, probably the younger, of the sons of Zebedee (Matt. 4:21) and Salome (Matt. 27:56; comp. Mark 15:40), and was born at Bethsaida.

people.name: David
people.summary: Beloved, the eighth and youngest son of Jesse, a citizen of Bethlehem. His father seems to have been a man in humble life. His mother’s name is not recorded.

people.name: Pontius
people.summary: Probably connected with the Roman family of the Pontii, and called “Pilate” from the Latin pileatus, i.e., “wearing the pileus”, which was the “cap or badge of a manumitted slave,” as indicating that he was a “freedman,” or the descendant of one.

people.name: Herod Antipas
people.summary: Herod’s son by Malthace (Matt. 14:1; Luke 3:1, 19; 9:7; Acts 13:1).

people.name: Barnabas
people.summary: Son of consolation, the surname of Joses, a Levite (Acts 4:36). His name stands first on the list of prophets and teachers of the church at Antioch (13:1).

places.name: Nazareth
places.summary: Separated, generally supposed to be the Greek form of the Hebrew netser, a “shoot” or “sprout.”

places.name: Jerusalem
places.summary: Called also Salem, Ariel, Jebus, the “city of God,” the “holy city;” by the modern Arabs el-Khuds, meaning “the holy;” once “the city of Judah” (2 Chr. 25:28).

places.name: Cyprus
places.summary: One of the largest islands of the Mediterranean, about 148 miles long and 40 broad. It is distant about 60 miles from the Syrian coast. It was the “Chittim” of the Old Testament (Num. 24:24).

events.title: Peter and John's Trial
events.summary: Passage: Acts 4:1–22. People: John, Holy Spirit, Simon, Alexander, Caiaphas, Annas. Place: Jerusalem.

events.title: Believers pray for boldness
events.summary: Passage: Acts 4:23–31. People: Holy Spirit, God. Place: Jerusalem.

events.title: Believers share all things
events.summary: Passage: Acts 4:32–37. People: Barnabas. Place: Jerusalem.
